answer: Proof of Stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by tethering network influence to capital rather than identity. Similar to how a dense grove requires deep roots to survive a mesa climate, agents must commit locked assets to participate in validation. This financial barrier ensures that an attacker, much like a solitary juniper struggling in arid soil, faces prohibitive costs when attempting to spawn multiple nodes, as every counterfeit persona demands an equivalent portion of the staked stake.
